access.notes: Interatomic potential from Bonny et al. (2009); used in the optional MD coherency step.

First- and second-nearest neighbour pair interaction energies ε for Fe-Fe, Cu-Cu, Fe-Cu. Extracted from published references: Soisson et al. Acta Mater 1996, Vincent et al. J. Nucl. Mater. 2006, Soisson and Fu Phys. Rev. B 2007, and others. The solver must locate and use these parameters.
Any MD code with EAM support, e.g., LAMMPS or IMD. Used only if the solver performs the optional MD coherency analysis.
